_meta._note: Every email, phone, WhatsApp and map value found anywhere in the frontend, with exact source locations.
_meta.method: Regex sweep over the entire frontend repository (excluding package-lock.json) for email patterns, tel: links, wa.me links, +91 numbers and map URLs.
_meta.ownerDecision: D-004: current frontend emails are the initial values. Do not invent or replace.

whatsappFindings.twoDifferentUrlFormats: api.whatsapp.com/send?phone=... (static href in site.ts) AND wa.me/<digits>?text=... (built by whatsappUrl()). Both preserved.
whatsappFindings.criticalConstraint: AppointmentForm.tsx:46-48 - window.open MUST stay synchronous. Source comment: 'Must stay synchronous: an async gap here loses the gesture context and the browser blocks the tab.' Do not introduce an await before it.
